name: Insistent Privacy Fence
disable: DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to carefully disconnect the coil from the fence or DC 30 Crafting check (master) to jury-rig a grounding device to nullify the shock
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

items.name: Shock
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the fence directly or with a tool or weapon

---

Effect The fence deals 7d12 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 26 basic Reflex save save).

text: A stretch of fence is electrified by a hidden Stasian coil.
